ContextMenu_LGTankerFuelBridge_Direction: Click to swap the transfer direction. This can be changed while transfer is on.
ContextMenu_LGTankerFuelBridge_Tooltip: When a supported fuel tanker is parked within the configured range, this LG Extended Plumbing barrel receives up to 10 L of petrol every 10 in-game minutes. It will not replace other liquids. Change the range in Sandbox Options.
ContextMenu_LGTankerFuelBridge_DrainTool: Transfers up to 10 L of petrol from this barrel into a nearby parked supported tanker every 10 in-game minutes. The barrel must contain petrol only and the tanker needs free fuel-tank capacity.
